title: 第23章 选择宗门第24章 离开
slug: 开局战五渣我靠空间挂机修仙
content_zh:
测试人员对他明显没有像对王宝乐那样热情，问过姓名后，把刻录灵根信息的木牌递给了秦怀安。
秦怀安并未觉得失落，毕竟他也猜到了自己的灵根资质不会太好。不过还好不算太差，有了进入招收广场的资格。
走进广场，各个大小宗门都各自占据一块地方，每家都树立着一块牌子，上面写着招收的要求。
入口处，一个名叫凌云殿的小宗门的招收要求：上品灵根可直接收为亲传弟子，由殿主亲自收徒；中品灵根收为内门弟子，下品灵根者，如果年龄不大于30岁且修为已达到炼气三层，可收为外门弟子。
秦怀安听说过这个叫凌云殿的宗门，是启国的北部的一个宗门，殿主是一位筑基期的强者。
见两人在牌子前伫立，凌云殿驻地内很快走出来了一个身穿白色道袍的中年修士，此人炼气九层修为，显得极为热情。
“两位道友，我来给二位介绍一下我们凌云殿。我凌云殿是启国北方最大的宗门，殿主修为高深，一套凌云刀法独步启国修真界。”
“不知二位是何灵根？”
“在下中品灵根。”
“在下上品灵根。”
“幸会幸会！”中年修士对王宝乐抱拳道。
然后就不再理会王宝乐，朝着秦怀安说道：“我看道友年纪轻轻已是炼气六层修为，如果加入我凌云殿，必会作为核心弟子培养。假以时日，凌云殿必有道友一席之地。”
秦怀安笑着抱拳道：“在下一定认真考虑。”
见秦怀安没有继续询问，中年修士已是明白他应该是不会加入凌云殿了。又客套几句后，秦怀安和王宝乐继续往前走去。
走了一圈，两人对广场内各宗门的布局有了大概的了解。
外围的都是一些小门派，足有数十家家；再往靠中间一点就是四家二流宗门，最中间是黄山剑宗的驻地。
秦怀安也看到了丹霞宗的驻地，丹霞宗的招收要求是上品灵根可收为亲传弟子；中品灵根且修为在炼气中期以上可收为内门弟子；其他中品灵根，以及下品灵根且修为在炼气中期以上可收为外门弟子，如果炼丹天赋出众，可特殊考虑。
总体来说，同样资质的修士，在越小的宗门就越受到重视。
鸟随鸾凤飞腾远，秦怀安决定还是看看能不能进入黄山剑宗。
走到广场中央黄山剑宗的驻地，黄山剑宗的告示牌前已经围了很多人。

秦怀安和王宝乐挤在人群中看着黄山剑宗的招收条件。极品灵根可直接收为亲传弟子，上品灵根可收为内门弟子，后期根据在宗门内的表现，择优收为亲传弟子。中品灵根可直接收为外门弟子，下品灵根且修为达到炼气后期者，也可收为外门弟子。
秦怀安暗暗咋舌，黄山剑宗要求要高很多，只有上品灵根的才会直接收为内门弟子。一上午的测试中，上品灵根者总共也没几个。
当然后面还有很多未测试的修士，但按比例来说，上品灵根确实极为稀少。
其他门派的招收条件上都没有极品灵根这一项，秦怀安明白，在黄山剑宗势力范围内，所有被测试出来的极品灵根应该都被收入了黄山剑宗。
一代代的选拔下来，有天赋的修士大部分都进了黄山剑宗，其他宗门很难有反抗黄山剑宗的实力。

content_en:
The testers were obviously not as enthusiastic about him as they were toward Wang Baole. After asking for his name, they handed Qin Huaian the wooden plaque with the spiritual root information.
Qin Huaian did not feel disappointed. After all, he also guessed that his spiritual root qualifications were not very good. Fortunately, it's not too bad, and I have the qualifications to enter the recruitment square.
Walking into the square, each sect, large or small, occupies a space, and each sect has a sign with recruitment requirements written on it.
At the entrance, there are recruitment requirements for a small sect called Lingyun Palace: those with high-grade spiritual roots can be accepted directly as direct disciples, and the master of the palace will personally accept disciples; those with medium-grade spiritual roots can be accepted as inner disciples, and those with lower-grade spiritual roots can be accepted as outer disciples if they are not older than 30 years old and have reached the third level of Qi Refining.
Qin Huaian had heard of this sect called Lingyun Palace, which was a sect in the northern part of Qi State. The master of the palace was a strong man in the foundation building stage.
Seeing the two people standing in front of the sign, a middle-aged monk wearing a white robe quickly walked out of the Lingyun Palace station. This man was at the ninth level of Qi refining and looked extremely enthusiastic.
"Two Taoist friends, let me introduce our Lingyun Palace to you. Our Lingyun Palace is the largest sect in the north of Qi Kingdom. The master of the palace has a profound level of cultivation. His set of Lingyun sword skills is unique in Qi Kingdom's cultivation world."
"I wonder what spiritual roots you two are?"
"I have a middle-grade spiritual root."
"Here are the upper-grade spiritual roots."
"Nice to meet you!" the middle-aged monk said to Wang Baole, cupping his fists.
Then he ignored Wang Baole and said to Qin Huaian: "I see that fellow Taoist has reached the sixth level of Qi Refining at a young age. If he joins me in Lingyun Palace, he will be trained as a core disciple. In time, fellow Taoist will have a place in Lingyun Palace."
Qin Huaian smiled and clasped his fists and said, "I will definitely consider it seriously."
Seeing that Qin Huaian did not continue to ask, the middle-aged monk already understood that he would not join Lingyun Palace. After a few more polite words, Qin Huaian and Wang Baole continued to walk forward.
After walking around, the two of them had a general understanding of the layout of the various sects in the square.
There are some small sects on the periphery, with dozens of sects in total; further in the middle are four second-rate sects, and in the middle is the headquarters of the Huangshan Sword Sect.
Qin Huaian also saw the Danxia Sect's residence. The Danxia Sect's recruitment requirements are that those with high-grade spiritual roots can be accepted as direct disciples; those with middle-grade spiritual roots and whose cultivation is above the middle stage of Qi Refining can be admitted as inner disciples; other middle-grade spiritual roots, as well as those with lower-grade spiritual roots and whose cultivation is above the middle stage of Qi Refining can be admitted as outer disciples. If you have outstanding alchemy talent, special consideration will be given.
Generally speaking, monks with the same qualifications are more valued in smaller sects.
The bird followed the phoenix and flew far away, Qin Huaian decided to see if he could enter the Huangshan Sword Sect.
Walking to the center of the square where the Huangshan Sword Sect is stationed, a lot of people were already gathered in front of the Huangshan Sword Sect's notice board.
Qin Huaian and Wang Baole crowded in the crowd and looked at the recruitment conditions of the Huangshan Sword Sect. Those with top-grade spiritual roots can be directly accepted as direct disciples, and those with high-grade spiritual roots can be accepted as inner disciples. In the later stage, based on their performance in the sect, the best ones will be accepted as direct disciples. Those with middle-grade spiritual roots can be directly accepted as outer disciples, and those with lower-grade spiritual roots and whose cultivation has reached the late stage of Qi refining can also be accepted as outer disciples.
Qin Huaian was secretly stunned. Huangshan Sword Sect's requirements were much higher. Only those with high-grade spiritual roots would be directly accepted as inner disciples. In the morning's test, there were only a few people with high-grade spiritual roots.
Of course, there are many untested monks later, but proportionally speaking, high-grade spiritual roots are indeed extremely rare.
The recruitment conditions of other sects do not include top-grade spiritual roots. Qin Huaian understands that within the scope of Huangshan Sword Sect's influence, all the top-grade spiritual roots that have been tested should be admitted to Huangshan Sword Sect.
After generations of selection, most of the talented monks have entered the Huangshan Sword Sect, and it is difficult for other sects to have the strength to resist the Huangshan Sword Sect.
